size_note: closed 91 x 50 x 25 mm (GSMArena; Softpedia 26 mm deep); the museum's closed shot gives 91 mm at 50 mm wide. Shown open: the keypad cover hangs below the body. The open length is measured on the museum's straight-on shot of the open phone (the cover lies flat: its length matches the closed shot) at 50 mm wide: 144.3 mm. The jog dial on the left side and the cover's hinge ears stand out of the 50 mm (layout_mm.parts). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD measures about 32 x 28 mm; 1.6in at the native 96 x 92

key_icons: Oval light keys with a thin outline in four columns, each digit with its small letters to its right; the fourth column reads a green handset (call), MEMO, C and a red handset with a power symbol (end). The 1 key also shows a small voicemail icon; the 0 key shows a space symbol and '+'; the # key shows '@'.
